title: In-app publish, browse, rating, report (wire decisions 8/9 to the backend) (AUTH #026)
summary: Wire the locked browse cards (DESIGN_SYSTEM decision 8) and results/store (decision 9) to the backend: publish from the results screen; browse feeds (Top this week / New / Near your scale) with diorama cards; the four-axis rating sheet; one-tap report + reason sheet; the 'Under review' badge; creator stats on the creator's own environments; deep links. No UI redesign — decisions 8/9 are locked (SPEC §3.7).

acceptance_tests.test: Browse shows diorama cards in the three sort tabs (Top this week / New / Near your scale); tapping Journey plays a published environment fetched via a signed URL.
The four-axis rating sheet and the one-tap report + reason sheet post to the backend (rate-limited); the 'Under review' badge shows on the creator's pending environments.
Publish from the results screen (decision 9) triggers the moderation pipeline (M4-DATA-03); creator stats (plays, completions, best times) show on the creator's own environments (creator-only in v1).
